description: Search recall campaigns by campaign number, by vehicle, or across every campaign by make, model, model year, and received date. campaignNumber returns that campaign with every vehicle it covers; make, model, and modelYear together return that vehicle's recalls; any other combination of make, model, modelYear, and dateRange is a broad search of NHTSA's recall files, newest first, paged with limit and offset. A broad search matches a campaign when one of its vehicle records carries every vehicle filter given, and the received date it reports can fall one day before the date the other modes report for the same campaign.

campaignNumber.description: NHTSA campaign number (e.g., "20V682000"). When provided, returns the campaign detail plus every vehicle it covers. A 6-character number (e.g., "00V419") returns every campaign it covers, each with its own detail and vehicles. Mutually exclusive with make/model/modelYear.

dateRange.description: Inclusive received-date bounds in YYYY-MM-DD, in every mode; a bound alone is a broad search. Blank bounds are unset; records without a usable date are excluded only with active bounds.

after.description: Inclusive lower bound, a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means unset.

before.description: Inclusive upper bound, a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means unset.

limit.description: Campaigns per page of a broad search. Defaults to 20; at most 50 per page. Not accepted with campaignNumber or a full make + model + modelYear lookup, which return every match.

make.description: Vehicle make (e.g., "Toyota"). With model and modelYear, looks up that vehicle's recalls; otherwise a broad-search filter matching the whole make name, ignoring case.

model.description: Vehicle model. With make and modelYear, looks up that vehicle's recalls; otherwise a broad-search filter matching the whole model name, ignoring case.

modelYear.description: Model year, a whole number. With make and model, looks up that vehicle's recalls; otherwise a broad-search filter.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the newest-first results of a broad search. Defaults to 0. Not accepted with campaignNumber or a full make + model + modelYear lookup.

name: nhtsa_search_recalls

effectiveQuery.description: The search key used: campaign number, "make model modelYear" for a vehicle lookup, or the broad-search filters as key=value pairs with make and model uppercased as matched, plus any active date bounds.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mode_conflict`: campaignNumber was combined with make, model, or modelYear; or limit or offset was sent with campaignNumber or a full make + model + modelYear lookup. `missing_required_combo`: No campaignNumber, make, model, modelYear, or active dateRange bound was supplied. `limit_too_large`: limit exceeds the 50-row page maximum on a server set to reject an over-maximum limit rather than lower it. `campaign_not_found`: The campaignNumber did not match any NHTSA recall. `invalid_date`: A dateRange bound is not a calendar-valid YYYY-MM-DD date. `inverted_date_range`: dateRange.after is later than dateRange.before. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Broad search only: pagination limit used for this page

notice.description: Guidance when no recalls match: for a vehicle lookup, how to list the other model names NHTSA may file its recalls under with nhtsa_lookup_vehicles operation="dataset_models"; for a broad search, which filters to relax. Also explains a date range that excluded every recall, a broad-search page past the last match, and a limit lowered to the page maximum.

offset.description: Broad search only: pagination offset used for this page

recalls.description: Matching recall campaigns; in a broad search, one page of them

affectedVehicles.description: Every distinct make/model the campaign covers (campaign queries). Equipment and tire campaigns name the part here — make is the brand, model is the part — and carry no model year.

items.description: One vehicle covered by the campaign

component.description: Affected component. A broad search joins all of the campaign's components with " | ".

consequence.description: Safety consequence. Omitted for older campaigns whose record leaves it blank.

investigationId.description: ODI investigation that preceded this campaign, when NHTSA links one (campaign queries) — pass it as nhtsaId to nhtsa_search_investigations for the full record.

overTheAirUpdate.description: OTA update availability when provided by NHTSA. Never set by a broad search: NHTSA's recall files carry no such flag.

parkIt.description: Do-not-drive advisory when provided by NHTSA

parkOutSide.description: Park-outside advisory when provided by NHTSA

potentialUnitsAffected.description: Units affected (campaign queries and broad searches)

remedy.description: Corrective action. Omitted for older campaigns whose record leaves it blank.

summary.description: Recall summary. Omitted for older campaigns whose record leaves it blank.

returned.description: Broad search only: campaigns in this page

totalCount.description: Total recalls matching criteria; in a broad search, across every page

title: Nhtsa Search Recalls
